description.en: Plugins for Semdok Harness, made by Semdok.
Orchestrator mode: a lead agent splits big tasks across specialist agents (researcher, builder, reviewer, tester, writer) that work in parallel, then checks and merges their results.
BigQuery, Databricks and Gmail for the agent, through MCP servers: read-only BigQuery with a cost cap, Databricks Genie and SQL, Gmail read and drafts. Secrets never go through the chat.
Multi-agent stock and crypto research (TradingAgents by Tauric Research) on your Semdok models. Research only, not financial advice.
Add Sem, Semdok's 3D conversational assistant (live.semdok.com), to any website: HTML, React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow.
